notes.problem: The mast floats above the body, the left laptop screen pierces a drone arm, a ceiling slab is clipped at the top, a stray rod crosses the lower right.
notes.fix: Seat the mast, move the left laptop back so it clears the arm, delete the slab and the rod.

notes.problem: Wall seam at about y 370 through the headline, clipped ceiling light, dead violet void, near black primitive drone.
notes.fix: Lower and dolly in so the tabletop starts under the dek, drop the fixture out of frame, one continuous wall, a lit violet grey drone body with a rim light.

notes.problem: Three laptops and a monitor read, not four; dark primitive drone with a puck on a mast; a lid edge cuts a drone arm; clipped ceiling light; wall seam behind the headline.
notes.fix: Four laptops in a ring at table height around the drone, clear the lid from the arm, seat the puck on the body, crop the clipped light, a continuous wall behind the type.

notes.problem: A flat magenta field with no floor contact.
notes.fix: A lit studio surface with a soft contact shadow, the field toward violet.

notes.problem: Speckle on the glass strip, dead bottom third.
notes.fix: Clean glass with one specular edge, the held out tray down to the footer.

notes.problem: Isometric tray on a flat magenta field, lower right empty, an unexplained red strap on the held back box.
notes.fix: Pull the camera down and in so the box of 22 fills the lower right and bleeds off; delete the strap or make it a lid seal.

notes.problem: The trough filled almost to its stop reads as a percent gauge and competes with the ten readings.
notes.fix: Cut the trough or set the pill on the glass frame's rail and let the rods fill the lower half.

notes.problem: The channel reads full, so 97.5 against 100 is invisible; pins are untextured primitives.
notes.fix: A visible empty stub with an engraved stop line, the pill on it; knurled lit posts.

notes.problem: The upper frame still reads as orange tinted plastic over ten identical rods and competes with the gauge.
notes.fix: Make the rods a clear glass rack with amber only on the rim, push it back and up, let the gauge fill the lower half.

notes.problem: Streak grain across the upper sky.
notes.fix: Halve it and remove the horizontal streak.

notes.problem: Streak grain across the upper sky.
Horizontal streak grain reads as scanlines behind the dek.
notes.fix: Halve the grain and make it isotropic.

notes.problem: Wash seam at about y 370 behind the headline, glyphs read as texture, the pair in a raised rim.
notes.fix: Feather the type wash with no visible edge, crop the grid tighter, cut the pair into a recessed well.

notes.problem: Speckled canopies; the case competes with the drone.
notes.fix: S1's solid canopies; cut or close the case.

rounds_source: this module's own log of cards it has scored
rounds_declared_note: the cards carry a round number and it was not believed, because the cards carry [2, None, None] and a round is one number. `rounds` is this module's own count of 2
work_order: no judge found a hard fail, and the median 7.338 is under this round's rung of 7.7. KEEP EDITING: fix the judges' named defects, re-render and re-score. At the round cap the finished deck ships whatever it scored. Start with the frames the judges charge the art for, in this order, slides 4, 7, 8, 2, 6, 9 (`artwork_weakest_frames`), one concrete change each
